items.evidence: play --ticks N --inputs ... --settings F prints the brief's JSON object, but the starting-board option does not start the run in play: `play work --ticks 3 --set board=2` prints screen title, board null, and the engine warns 'the run set board and no rule read it'. Board 2 only begins after 0:enter. The README admits this ('I found no way for a run to skip the title screen'). The brief says the run then starts in play on that board.
--frame f.png --size 800x480 after runs on the title, settings, play (boards 1-3), paused, won and lost screens: every PNG header reads 800 x 480, and I opened each one.

The README command `play work --ticks 0 --sounds wavs` wrote coin 0.35 s, bounce 0.25 s, fall 0.9 s and clear 0.9 s, identical to the shipped work/sounds/*.wav. Peaks run 17k-29k and all four hashes differ. Their pitch shapes differ: coin two blips ~1.0-1.3 kHz, bounce a 170 Hz thump, fall a sweep from 525 down to 60 Hz, clear rising notes from 530 to 910 Hz.
At tick 5 the title shows selected Start. menu_down x3 then menu_up x3 gave Settings, Quit, Quit, Settings, Start, Start. 0:enter gave screen play, board 1, score 0, lives 3, texts 'Board 1 of 3'.

Settings opened on Volume 8 and English. menu_right/left stepped 8->9->10->9->...->0 and stopped at 0 and 10. On Language, right gave es and left gave en. Back+enter returned to title (selected Settings).

With es: title Empezar/Ajustes/Salir; settings Ajustes/Volumen: 0/Idioma: Espanol/Volver; play 'Tablero 2 de 3','Puntos: 0','Vidas: 3'; paused 'En pausa','Continuar','Salir al titulo'; won 'Has ganado','Puntos: 30','Intro: volver al titulo'; lost 'Fin del juego'. No English left except the game name Roll.
Run 1 with --settings judge-scratch/set1 set volume 5 and es. Run 2 with the same folder started at title with volume 5, es and Spanish texts. A run with no folder started at 8, en.
0:enter on board 1 with --at every tick: y 0.320 at t26, 0.2475 at t27 (first <=0.3); y back to 0.315 by t30 and peaks 0.49 at t41; second landing t55. At t601 y=0.24993, sounds [bounce,bounce] (2).

board=2, 0:enter, no input: at t1/100/200/301 there are 6 crates. Largest deviation from (0,0.25|0.75,-0.5|0|0.5) is 0.0008.

board=3, 0:enter,250:right,280:none,365:left,394:none: the ball settled on the bridge with x-bridge_x of -0.33 (t400), -0.43 (t580) and -0.55 (t800), following it out and back through two reversals with y 0.25 and no fall. 0:enter,60:right left the first slab at about t135 with the bridge near 1.5: y -1.5 by t180, fall at about t215, lives 2.

README script board=3 0:enter,160:right,175:none,520:right,550:none: screen won at t590, score 30, sounds end coin,clear. Ball, bridge_x and score were identical from t590 to t699 (even with right held from 600). Enter at 700 gave title.
0:enter,40:down: screen lost, lives 0 by t500. With 600:left, 650:up, score 10, ball (0,1.248,0), coins and sounds stayed unchanged to t699. 700:enter gave title.

Board 2 mid-strike, 145:escape: paused (Resume). Ball and crates were identical at t146/200/299 while right was held. 300:enter (Resume) went back to play and motion resumed. Board 3 100:escape froze bridge_x at 1.1 to t209, then menu_down and enter (Quit_to_title) gave title.
Two runs of board=2 0:enter,60:right,200:left --ticks 250 (crates knocked, one falling) gave byte-identical JSON (cmp).

f_b2.png at t160: perspective trapezoid seen from above and in front, the whole board in view. The red ball is beside the displaced crates and the one riding at (0.69,0.78) as in the state. Crates are boxes with lighter tops and darker sides, the ball has a darker lower rim, and coins (-1.5,1.5) and (3,-1) are visible. f_b3.png: two slabs, gap, and the green bridge at bridge_x 1.23 nearer the right slab.

Spanish frames f_title (Roll/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir), f_settings (Ajustes/Volumen: 5/Idioma: Espanol/Volver), f_paused (En pausa/Continuar/Salir al titulo), f_won (Has ganado/Puntos: 30) and f_lost (Fin del juego/Puntos: 10). The play frames show 'Board N of 3', 'Score', 'Lives' at the top left.

Not shown. The headless run has audio off, and the report has no sounds_heard line (asking for run.sounds_heard is refused), so no gain at volume 0 could be observed. The code plays every sound at gain 1.0. The README only says '(the engine scales it)' in a list of things the builder did not check, and does not point to where.

The README has controls and rules, and its three commands (play with --inputs/--set/--settings, --frame out/b3.png --size 800x480, --ticks 0 --sounds sounds) all worked as written from a fresh shell with no engine running. It also has a file-by-file map (game.json, modules/work/src/lib.rs, assets/ui, strings, sounds) and what the builder checked.

A crate knocked from the top row can ride on top of the rolling ball (crate at y 0.78-0.80 above the ball at x 0.7-1.1).
A ball wedged between the first slab's edge and the moving bridge was flung up to y 1.17 (board 3, 0:enter,250:right,280:none,365:left,396:none, t660-720).
The won/lost screens list the play HUD texts as well as their own in texts; the lost HUD shows 'Lives: 0'.
For board 1, crates is [] rather than null; harmless.
could_not_check: m23: no gain of a played sound can be read headless (audio off, no sounds_heard in the report), and neither the README nor the code shows where volume scales playback
